svg.title: ScaleFlow ERD: 30 model entities
svg.desc: All scalar and inherited columns, with local reference nodes for every relationship. See README.md for mapping limitations.
svg.text: 30 entities / 278 columns / 56 relationships | Logical model from C# source
PK = primary key FK = intended foreign key ? = nullable * = inherited column Dashed link = explicit mapping needed
Each FK points to a repeated reference box. 0..* child rows -> 1 required parent or 0..1 optional parent. Identity tables excluded.
